## Water Quality Monitoring

::: {.modules-intro}
A series of lessons using AI to explore and monitor Appalachian water resources.  
*Designed for 9th-12th grade students.*
:::

:::
:::

::: {.lesson-outline-section}
::: {.lesson-outline}

::: {.lesson-item}
### [Lesson 1: Statistics Fundamentals](1-statistics/)

Learn mean, median, range, standard deviation, and outliers using nitrate/nitrite data.

*Estimated time: 90 minutes*

<br>

[**Slides & Facilitator Guide**](1-statistics/facilitator){.facilitator .hidden}

:::

::: {.lesson-item}
### [Lesson 2: Classification & Color](2-classification/)

Learn about neural networks, classification, and how computers process color.

*Estimated time: 90 minutes*

<br>

[**Slides & Facilitator Guide**](2-classification/facilitator){.facilitator .hidden}
:::

::: {.lesson-item}
### [Lesson 3: Regression & Color](3-regression)

Learn about scatterplots, regression, and predicting nitrate concentrations.

*Estimated time: 90 minutes*

<br>

[**Slides & Facilitator Guide**](3-regression/facilitator){.facilitator .hidden}
:::

Use AI to assist in analysis of the data collected by the buoy.

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
  const facilitatorLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a.facilitator');

  try {
    const { data: { session }, error: sessionError } =
      await _supabase.auth.getSession();

    if (sessionError) throw sessionError;
    if (!session?.user) return;

    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await _supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('role')
      .eq('id', session.user.id)
      .single();

    if (profileError) throw profileError;

    if (profile?.role === 'teacher') {
      facilitatorLinks.forEach(link => link.classList.remove('hidden'));
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Could not check teacher access for facilitator links:', error);
  }
});
</script>
```
